verdict.rationale: The official quickstart promises a first API call "in under a minute" (gemini-docs-19). The free tier lets you start without payment (gemini-docs-14, gemini-comm-3), and official SDKs cover Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go and Java (gemini-docs-13, gemini-docs-30). Community comments about account and billing friction are perceptions rather than concrete quickstart failures, so they lower confidence but do not create a dispute (gemini-comm-2, gemini-comm-5). Missing for 10: no evidence that the quickstart shows runnable per-language code samples, and no independent hands-on confirmation of the minutes-to-first-call claim.
